endorsements.label: The UPS (Undetectable Packet Sniffer)
endorsements.description: Presentation of the UPS - the Undetectable Packet Sniffer: a Hostile packet sniffer posing as an Uninterruptible Power Supply. Complete HOW-TO: Hardware configuration, Software configuration, integration into a non-functional UPS, installation and use. Proof of concept project by the Tri-Valley Security Group (TVSG).
